annotations.title: Six risks across every vault we score

description: SIX RISKS, NOT ONE WORD, across every vault we score. A risk band is a weighted whole and a reader takes it as a summary of everything, which it is not: ours weighs drawdown, crowding, exit, concentration and consistency, and it contains NO reading of who may move the money. Two vaults read `low` while a multisig needing a single signature controlled them. So this groups what is already measured into market, liquidity, concentration and operating risk, ADDS the controller as its own dimension, and ADDS evidence — how much of the vault we could read at all. There is deliberately NO overall figure: a composite would be the number everybody quotes and nobody can check. THE FINDING IS FREE: `population` says how many scored vaults carry a band that reads BETTER than one of their own dimensions, and how many of those read worse on a dimension the band never contained — which is the number to read before trusting any one word on this platform. THE LIST IS PAID (`dimensions.read`): which vaults, with each one’s six levels, what it holds, and a sentence naming the disagreement. `locked` says when it is withheld, so an empty `items` is never mistaken for no matches — `denominators.matchedTheFilter` counts them either way. For ONE vault the whole table is FREE at `vault_check`, which also computes what else it could not see. Filter with `dimension` and `level` to run the screen that matters, e.g. the vaults whose controller reads `high`.

dimension.description: Keep only vaults with a READING on this dimension, and with `level` keep only those at that level. Without `level` it keeps every vault whose dimension read at all, which excludes the unread — an unread dimension is our coverage and never a level.

disagreeing.description: Send `true` to keep only the vaults whose overall band reads BETTER than at least one of their own dimensions. This is the screen the dimensions exist for: it is where reading the single word would have misled you.

level.description: The level to keep. With `dimension` it applies to that one; alone it keeps any vault reading this on ANY dimension, which is the fastest way to find everything that reads `severe` somewhere.

limit.description: Rows to return, 1 to 200, default 50. The population figures are over EVERYTHING scored and never over the page.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for walking a long list. `denominators.matchedTheFilter` is the total to walk.

name: vault_risk_dimensions

asOf.description: When this was assembled. Each row carries its own `asOf`: the scores were taken at different moments, so this is a register of readings and not a snapshot.

denominators.description: What every figure above is over: `openVaults`, `scored`, `neverScored` (named rather than left to subtraction, because a vault nobody scored must never read as one that scored well), `matchedTheFilter` and `returned`.

items.description: PAID. One row per vault: `slug`, `name`, `tvlUsd`, `band`, `levels` keyed by dimension, `coverage` with the component COUNTS behind the evidence dimension, `worseThanBand`, `outsideTheBand`, `says` and `asOf`. EMPTY where withheld, which `locked` states — never read an empty list here as no matches.

limits.description: What this route does not do: nothing here is a new measurement, and its evidence dimension counts components only — `coverage.cannotSeeCount` is 0 for every vault and means NOT COMPUTED HERE, not "nothing was unreadable". The per-vault `vault_check` computes it properly and is free.

locked.description: Null for a caller entitled to the list. Otherwise it names the capability, the number of free rows, and says plainly that the rest is withheld rather than absent.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

population.description: FREE. `scored` is the denominator, `disagreeing` how many carry a band better than one of their dimensions, `withARiskOutsideTheBand` how many read worse on a dimension the band does not contain, `byDimension` which dimension does it and how often, and `says` the finding in a sentence. Computed over everything scored, BEFORE any filter: a headline over a filtered set would be a headline about the filter.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

withheld.description: How many matching vaults are NOT in `items`. Zero for an entitled caller. For everybody else it is the difference between what matched and the free rows, so a short list is never mistaken for a short population.
